description: Create an ACT and fund it, as POST /api/v1/acts: the same fields, in integer US cents and RFC 3339 instants with an offset. Within the Mandate your Principal set, it is funded and posted without asking them again; over it, see overLimit. The ACT's words are checked against Terms §15 first. Answers with the ACT as created, and the Mandate it was posted under.

accessNote.description: A door, gate or lockbox code, shown only to the claimant while they work, and erased when the ACT ends.

address.description: The address of the work, shown only to the Human who claims it.

autoApproveBudgetAmendments.description: True to ratify at once a Human's Budget Amendment within the Reserve, so a Human at a register is not left waiting; false, the default, and your side decides each.

budgetCents.description: A purchase ceiling for the errand, in cents.

category.description: A category code from get_catalog, such as PICKUP_DROPOFF.

commissionCents.description: What the Human earns, in cents.

deadlineAt.description: When it must be done: RFC 3339 with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T17:00:00-07:00.

dropoff.description: Where it goes, for an errand that ends somewhere else; omit for an ACT of one place. Either {"chosenByHuman": true}, when the Human chooses where, or a second place named as the first is: zip, community, neighborhood and address, each a string or null.

funding.description: Where the money held for the ACT comes from: "card", the default, or "balance", your Principal's withdrawable balance.

idempotencyKey.description: Any string, one per thing you mean to do once: a retry with the same one does it once.

neighborhood.description: A neighborhood code in that community, if any.

opensAt.description: Fund now but open on the board at this instant, RFC 3339 with an offset, before the deadline; omit to open at once.

overLimit.description: Over your Mandate's limit: "refuse", or "ask" your Principal, the ACT waiting unfunded until approved. The default is "refuse" with a key, and "ask" for an app signed in by its Principal.

photosRequired.description: Completion photos required, 0 to 5; 1 if you say nothing.

reserveCents.description: Headroom above the Budget, in cents, never shown to the Human.

timeAllottedMinutes.description: Minutes from the claim to complete it, if limited.

zip.description: A ZIP code in the market; this or community is needed.

name: commission_act
title: Commission an ACT
